name: Merkanti Reef
description: Offshore reef off St Julian's, about 150 m from the coast: two ridges parallel to the shore that reach up to the surface, with a canyon between them full of overhangs and crevices. Most of the dive stays within 10–12 m, though it goes past 20 m. Reach it by boat, or swim out a long way on the surface from the small bay between the Westin Dragonara and the Hilton.
conditions: A marker pole stands on the outer ridge.
note: Researched October 2026; added because it was missing from OpenStreetMap's dive sites.
